name: What to Expect During a Full Kitchen Renovation

step.name: Step 1: Existing-Condition Survey — This is where we assess your current kitchen, documenting every detail. It’s crucial for understanding what we’re working with and for accurate design and planning.
step.text: Step 1: Existing-Condition Survey — This is where we assess your current kitchen, documenting every detail. It’s crucial for understanding what we’re working with and for accurate design and planning.

step.name: Step 2: Design and Engineering — Based on your vision and the survey, we'll develop a detailed design, including any necessary engineering for structural changes. This is where your dream kitchen truly starts to take shape.
step.text: Step 2: Design and Engineering — Based on your vision and the survey, we'll develop a detailed design, including any necessary engineering for structural changes. This is where your dream kitchen truly starts to take shape.

step.name: Step 3: Detailed Scope and Budget — We'll finalize all the specifics of the project, including a clear scope of work and a transparent budget. This ensures everyone is on the same page.
step.text: Step 3: Detailed Scope and Budget — We'll finalize all the specifics of the project, including a clear scope of work and a transparent budget. This ensures everyone is on the same page.

step.name: Step 4: Appliance and Fixture Specifications — All your chosen appliances and fixtures are precisely specified, ensuring compatibility and functionality within the new design. This includes everything from the oven to the faucets.
step.text: Step 4: Appliance and Fixture Specifications — All your chosen appliances and fixtures are precisely specified, ensuring compatibility and functionality within the new design. This includes everything from the oven to the faucets.

step.name: Step 5: Permit and Approval Planning — If your renovation involves significant changes like moving gas lines or structural work, we'll handle the necessary permits and approvals with local authorities, like those in Berkeley. This is a critical step to ensure everything is up to code.
step.text: Step 5: Permit and Approval Planning — If your renovation involves significant changes like moving gas lines or structural work, we'll handle the necessary permits and approvals with local authorities, like those in Berkeley. This is a critical step to ensure everything is up to code.

step.name: Step 6: Ordering Long-Lead Materials — We’ll place orders for materials with longer delivery times, like custom cabinetry or special countertops, to minimize delays later in the process.
step.text: Step 6: Ordering Long-Lead Materials — We’ll place orders for materials with longer delivery times, like custom cabinetry or special countertops, to minimize delays later in the process.

step.name: Step 7: Protection and Demolition — We carefully protect your home, then begin the demolition phase, safely removing old elements to prepare for the new.
step.text: Step 7: Protection and Demolition — We carefully protect your home, then begin the demolition phase, safely removing old elements to prepare for the new.

step.name: Step 8: Rough-in Work — This involves framing, and rough plumbing, electrical, and HVAC installations. These foundational elements are critical and will undergo inspections.
step.text: Step 8: Rough-in Work — This involves framing, and rough plumbing, electrical, and HVAC installations. These foundational elements are critical and will undergo inspections.

step.name: Step 9: Inspections — Local building inspectors will check the rough-in work to ensure everything meets code before we proceed.
step.text: Step 9: Inspections — Local building inspectors will check the rough-in work to ensure everything meets code before we proceed.

step.name: Step 10: Installation and Finishes — Cabinets, countertops, flooring, backsplash, painting, trim, and appliance installations all happen now. We're bringing your kitchen to life!
step.text: Step 10: Installation and Finishes — Cabinets, countertops, flooring, backsplash, painting, trim, and appliance installations all happen now. We're bringing your kitchen to life!

step.name: Step 11: Testing and Punch-List Completion — We’ll test everything to ensure it’s working perfectly, and then address any final details on a punch list. This is the last step before you enjoy your amazing new kitchen.
step.text: This structured approach ensures that your full kitchen renovation progresses smoothly and efficiently, minimizing surprises and maximizing satisfaction.
